label: Cars
definition: Vehicles as a topic for noticing and comparing motion.
scope_notes: Use toys or hypothetical records; no current product rankings.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Music
definition: Organized sound and silence as a topic for listening and making.
scope_notes: No particular style or meter is universal.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Cooking
definition: Preparing food as a context for quantities, combinations and changes.
scope_notes: Initial activities use paper or empty containers; no food handling is required.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Plants
definition: Living organisms explored through their structures, needs and changes.
scope_notes: Examples must specify the kind of plant and relevant conditions.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Building
definition: Designing and assembling structures as a context for shapes and dimensions.
scope_notes: Use small, stable tabletop models.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Distance traveled
definition: The length of a route traveled by an object.
scope_notes: Distance traveled and displacement need not be equal.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Elapsed time
definition: The duration between a chosen start and end.
scope_notes: State the start, end and unit when comparing.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Average speed
definition: Distance traveled divided by elapsed time.
scope_notes: An interval average does not describe every moment of motion.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Average acceleration
definition: Change in velocity divided by the elapsed time.
scope_notes: Velocity includes direction. A time alone is not acceleration.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Steady beat
definition: A regularly recurring pulse used to organize musical timing.
scope_notes: A rhythm may contain several sounds within one beat.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Tempo
definition: The rate of the underlying musical beat.
scope_notes: More notes do not necessarily mean a faster tempo.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Rate
definition: A quantity expressed per unit of another quantity.
scope_notes: Name both quantities and units; not every rate measures time.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Rhythm
definition: The arrangement of sound durations and silences in time.
scope_notes: Rhythm can vary while the underlying beat remains steady.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Repeating pattern
definition: A sequence built by recurring instances of a recognizable unit.
scope_notes: Only some musical patterns repeat exactly.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Equal parts
definition: Parts equal in the relevant measure of a stated whole.
scope_notes: Specify equality of area, duration, volume or another measure.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Fractions
definition: Numbers that can describe equal parts relative to a specified whole.
scope_notes: Part-whole models are an entry point; fractions also have other interpretations.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Measurement
definition: Comparing a quantity with an agreed unit.
scope_notes: A measurement needs a quantity, value and unit.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Equivalent fractions
definition: Different fraction representations with the same value.
scope_notes: Compare using the same whole in visual models.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Plant parts
definition: Structures such as roots, stems and leaves that serve functions.
scope_notes: Plant structures vary; not every specimen has every listed part.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Plant needs
definition: Conditions and resources that support a plant’s survival and growth.
scope_notes: Needs depend on species and life stage; seeds and mature plants may differ.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Fair test
definition: A comparison designed to separate the factor of interest from other influences.
scope_notes: One simple comparison rarely establishes a universal cause.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Observation
definition: A recorded description or measurement of what was noticed.
scope_notes: Keep observations distinguishable from explanations and guesses.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Length
definition: The extent of something along one dimension.
scope_notes: State units and align measuring tools consistently.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Perimeter
definition: The total length around a plane figure’s boundary.
scope_notes: Boundary length differs from surface area.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Area
definition: The measure of a two-dimensional region.
scope_notes: Use square units; boundary length alone does not determine area.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Rectangle
definition: A quadrilateral with four right angles.
scope_notes: A square is a particular rectangle.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Triangle
definition: A polygon with three sides.
scope_notes: Rotating a triangle does not change its identity.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Square unit
definition: An area unit represented by a square with unit-length sides.
scope_notes: A unit square is a model for area, not a unit of perimeter.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Change
definition: A difference between states or measurements.
scope_notes: Specify what changed and the comparison being made.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.

label: Comparison
definition: Examining similarities or differences using explicit criteria.
scope_notes: A useful comparison states which attributes matter.
educator_notes: Illustrative draft; educator may revise or replace.
